name: arm raise step in place
source_instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step in place, lifting your knees.
Raise your arms overhead as you step.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.

phases.label: Alternating knee lifts and overhead raises
